review_notes.evidence: MC997 AC exact.png shows a severely damaged function glyph: surviving rounded upper/left ink and a small lower fragment, candidates A/C/R. Retained � after completed independent root focused source reading also could not resolve the damaged glyph; no circuit-based inference.

Adjacent c114/115 crossings have no printed diamonds. Lower AP/AJ/AG returns use c113/114/115, with only explicit native junctions. Owner final geometry and full preview comparison complete.

Root independently examined AC exact.png and agrees function is unresolved. Root examined footer native.png: AF4 first socket glyph is damaged and K-shaped, not confidently K; retained � in the main and associated continuation reference. A1 N2 and M5B connector suggestions are recorded as secondary evidence only and do not override native literal or damaged fields. Independent root whole-page native/model/final-preview review completed and passed.
